data.why: The Orbit Trajectory page has a built-in 'Generate Example' tab (elliptical orbit) and a pasted example trajectory, and the 3D Explorer uses bundled planet field model coefficients under planetmagfields/data/ plus coastline .npz files under streamlit_app/data/, so no external files are needed.

goals: Select a planet and magnetic field model and render its 3D surface radial field (Br) with field-line tracing
Compare the Lowes power spectrum and dipolarity/symmetry metrics across models or planets
Adjust Earth's IGRF model epoch (year) and radius to see how the dipole tilt and surface field evolve
Upload or generate a spacecraft/orbit trajectory and compute the magnetic field components (Br, Btheta, Bphi) along it
Visualize an orbit trajectory in 3D overlaid on the planet's surface field and export the computed field values as CSV

review.summary: The tree describes what the app is for (comparing published planetary field models in 3D, with their spectra and dipolarity, then predicting and exporting the field along a spacecraft path), and all ten screens I opened show what the nodes claim. It needs only small fixes before filing: the one-of input task wrongly includes the unit setting and leaves out upload, and the model-choice task is mislabelled and out of order.
